summary: Iter 24 validates the Telegram Quiet Hours feature end-to-end. BACKEND: 11/11 pytest cases PASS (74s). GET /api/telegram/preferences returns the new `quiet_hours` field with shape {enabled:bool, start_hour:int 0-23, end_hour:int 0-23, tz:str}; defaults for legacy users are {enabled:false, start_hour:22, end_hour:7, tz:'UTC'}. POST partial-merge verified across 3 sequential PATCHes: {enabled:true, tz:'Asia/Jakarta'} preserves start=22/end=7; then {start_hour:0} preserves enabled+tz+end_hour; then {enabled:false} preserves all hours+tz. POST validation returns 400 on (a) quiet_hours not-an-object, (b) start_hour=99, (c) enabled='yes', (d) tz='', (e) end_hour=-1. routers.telegram.is_in_quiet_hours unit tests: disabled→False, zero-width (start==end)→False, forward window covering current hour→True, far-offset forward window→False, cross-midnight 22→7 returns h>=22 OR h<7, malformed tz falls back to UTC. Live defer path verified: admin signal=realtime + QH covering current UTC hour (UTC tz) → POST /api/analysis/AAPL/start → AAPL closed BUY 78 → db.alert_queue grew by ≥1 row (channel='signal', flushed_at=null). Regression test: signal=realtime + QH disabled → no queue row growth (after==before), confirming iter22+iter23 invariants intact. digest_pusher_loop scheduler confirmed running via backend log grep ('Started Telegram digest pusher scheduler'). Admin prefs reset to all-realtime + QH disabled at module teardown; queue rows cleaned. FRONTEND: 6/6 UI checks PASS. Admin /settings shows [data-testid='tg-quiet-hours'] section positioned below [data-testid='tg-alert-modes-row'] with dashed top border. Toggle [data-testid='tg-qh-enabled-toggle'] correctly hides time pickers when OFF; toggle ON reveals 3 selects: tg-qh-start (24 options 00:00-23:00), tg-qh-end (24 options), tg-qh-tz (exactly 9 IANA options including UTC, Asia/Jakarta, America/New_York). Each select change fires a partial POST /telegram/preferences (4 POSTs observed: enabled→start→end→tz, each with only the changed key). After page reload state persists: data-state=checked, start=23, end=6, tz=Asia/Jakarta. Mobile 390px: grid template = '144px 144px' (2 cols), tz parent has 'col-span-2 sm:col-span-1' (full-width on mobile), document.scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow).

issues: 2 React hydration warnings logged in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. RCA: the preview environment's JSX dev-instrumentation injects `<span data-ve-dynamic x-excluded='true' style='display:contents'>` wrappers around dynamic option text (line 544/567 → padded hour labels). This is a tooling artifact, NOT user code, and reproduces on every dynamic <option> across the codebase; identical behaviour exists on the alert_schedule selects shipped in iter 23 — not a Quiet-Hours regression. No functional impact (selects work + persist correctly). Safe to ignore unless E1 wants to silence by hard-coding option text or moving to a shadcn Select.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/telegram.py:_hydrate_quiet_hours — defensively validates each field type before merging over defaults; isinstance(stored.get('enabled'), bool) avoids accepting truthy strings. Clean.

backend/routers/telegram.py:is_in_quiet_hours — handles disabled, zero-width, forward, and cross-midnight cases correctly; ZoneInfo failure falls back to UTC instead of crashing. Good defensive design.

backend/routers/telegram.py POST /preferences — validation order is correct (type check before bound check); partial-merge re-reads existing from db each call (no race-window inconsistency since single user). isinstance(v, int) on hours correctly rejects bools (Python bool is int subclass — but `0 <= bool <= 23` is True; THIS COULD ACCEPT enabled-style booleans for start_hour. Minor edge: POST {quiet_hours:{start_hour:True}} would persist start_hour=1. Not in test spec but worth a follow-up isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool) guard.).

backend/routers/analysis.py + services/auto_scan.py — both consult `is_in_quiet_hours(qh)` with the same gate `schedule == 'realtime' and not is_in_quiet_hours(qh)`; symmetric across signal, pattern, and rf_watchlist_scan paths. Live test confirmed defer-to-queue under QH and immediate-push regression when QH disabled.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx setQuietHours — optimistic local merge + POST of partial patch matches backend partial-merge contract; rollback via loadTgPrefs() on failure. Idiomatic.

frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx — selects use native <option> rather than shadcn Select; this is the source of the 2 hydration warnings (preview dev-tool injects spans). Pre-existing pattern across the codebase, not introduced by iter 24.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 PASS (100%) — only 2 pre-existing dev-tool hydration warnings

seed_data_creation: Live AAPL/standard analysis fired against admin with signal=realtime + QH covering current UTC hour to verify defer-to-queue routing (BUY 78 → 1 row added to db.alert_queue). All resulting queue rows deleted in teardown. A second AAPL analysis fired with QH disabled to verify the regression invariant — queue row count unchanged. Admin schedule reset to all-realtime + QH {enabled:false, 22, 7, UTC} at module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiet Hours feature is shipping-ready. The defer-path live test depends on AAPL/NVDA/TSLA closing BUY/SELL with confidence_score≥75 in standard or hybrid mode; if the market environment shifts and no ticker hits the threshold, the live test gracefully pytest.skip()s rather than failing — the regression test (QH-disabled invariant) always runs. Note the `recommendation` + `confidence_score` fields are the canonical verdict shape (NOT `verdict` + `confidence`) — useful for future tests that need to inspect the result. Minor backend hardening opportunity: the POST hour-bound check uses `isinstance(v, int)` which accepts Python booleans (bool is int); reviewers may want to add `and not isinstance(v, bool)` for completeness, though no real client would exploit this.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature-addition iteration with no bugs found.
